scientific_integrity: Analytical derivation of sharp fixed-error tails and necessary-and-sufficient almost-sure cutoff; finite checker is supporting evidence, not an infinite proof. Literature precedence beyond inspected sources remains possible.
scientific_limitations: Only independent complete re-randomization across integer sample sizes, fixed odd replication, one-dimensional equal-width strata, and the integrable power-log family are covered. No statement about nested samplers, general multivariate integrands, or optimal cost is made.
title: Sharp replica and logarithmic strong-law thresholds for stratified endpoint quadrature
